WITH rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 'endpoint'::text endpoint,200 status,'raw/synthetic-metadata-key' path,NULL::text ordinal,repeat('a',64) sha256,'ready'::text readiness,0 errors), bounded AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(octet_length(endpoint),0)<=128 AND coalesce(octet_length(path),0)<=2048
 AND coalesce(octet_length(ordinal),0)<=32 AND coalesce(octet_length(sha256),0)<=64 AND coalesce(octet_length(readiness),0)<=32
 THEN jsonb_build_array(endpoint,status,path,ordinal,sha256,readiness,errors) END item FROM rows), encoded AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN '[]' WHEN count(*)<=2048 AND bool_and(item IS NOT NULL)
 THEN jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item->>0)::text END payload,count(*) row_count FROM bounded)
 SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(payload)<=%s THEN payload END,row_count,octet_length(payload) FROM encoded

r.status,CASE WHEN octet_length(coalesce(r.ref->>'path',r.ref->>'shard'))<=2048 THEN coalesce(r.ref->>'path',r.ref->>'shard') END,
CASE WHEN octet_length(r.ref->>'ordinal')<=32 THEN r.ref->>'ordinal' END,encode(o.sha256,'hex'),o.size,o.updated_at,(r.error IS NOT NULL AND r.error <> 'null'::jsonb)
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN statarena.resources r ON r.endpoint=%s AND r.params=%s
LEFT JOIN statarena.objects o ON o.path=coalesce(r.ref->>'path',r.ref->>'shard')

sql.wide: SELECT d.legacy_object_path,r.external_key,r.locator,s.source_record_id,s.revision_id,s.match_id,s.player_id,s.team_id,s.match_player_revision_id,s.source_id,s.period_code,s.period_definition_version,s.variant_key,s.recorded_from_gen,s.aerial_duels_attempted,s.aerial_duels_won,s.assists,s.big_chances_created,s.blocks,s.chances_created,s.clearances,s.defensive_actions,s.dribbles_completed,s.dribbles_attempted,s.duels_lost,s.duels_won,s.goals,s.goals_prevented,s.interceptions,s.minutes_played,s.non_penalty_xg,s.passes_completed,s.passes_attempted,s.passes_final_third,s.provider_rating,s.recoveries,s.saves,s.shots,s.shots_on_target,s.tackles,s.touches,s.touches_box,s.xa,s.xg,s.xgot,ma.public_key,pa.public_key,ta.public_key FROM football.player_match_stats s JOIN ingest.source_records r ON r.id=s.source_record_id JOIN ingest.source_documents d ON d.id=r.document_id JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current ma ON ma.route_kind='match' AND ma.match_id=s.match_id JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current pa ON pa.route_kind='player' AND pa.player_id=s.player_id JOIN ingest.public_aliases_current ta ON ta.route_kind='team' AND ta.team_id=s.team_id WHERE s.is_canonical AND s.recorded_to_gen IS NULL ORDER BY s.source_record_id
